::: {#hero-heading}

<span class="section-label">who am i</span>

**Senior Technical Lead – Statistical Programming · Clinical Data Scientist · PhD Candidate**

I have **close to a decade** of experience specializing in clinical data analysis, CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM), and TLG/TFL programming. Currently **Senior Technical Lead – Statistical Programming at Ephicacy** and PhD candidate in Statistics at Amity University, based in **Trivandrum, Kerala, India**.

I build R packages, automate clinical pipelines, present at international PHUSE conferences, and teach Biostatistics.
